content:
Jesus is the fullness of all Creation, He is the state of God manifest in everything, from the smallest quark to the biggest Galaxy, He fills all in all. The best that anything can be is Perfect and Jesus is the Perfection of all things visible and invisible. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Religion was never meant to be a destination nor to get you to one, it was a journey that proved that man was far from God, and that there was nothing in his power that could bring Him to Oneness with divinity. Jesus is not a figure of religion, He is the Truth and reality that fills all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Kingdom of God and it's Power are not immaterial, alot of things in Christianity have been left to the unseen and intangible realm. The Kingdom of God and Perfection are seen, experienced and manifested, the Kingdom age is the bringing of both the Physical and the Spiritual realm into their Perfect state. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus did not come so that we may follow Him, He came to bring us into the fullness of His state, to be How He is. That is the fullness of the purpose of God for all Creation. To follow Jesus Christ is religion, but to be brought into oneness with Him is Perfection. That which is PERFECT is Come. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Holiness is not a product of ones deeds or lifestyle, to define Holiness as a way of doing things is to relegate it to an act, which in turn would mean it has nothing to do with the doer of the act, it is separate from the individual. Perfection is the Manifestation of Oneness with all God is, this is where holiness is a Manifestation, not a deed. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to give life and that more abundantly, the issue is many have not understood the concept of life, some believe it refers to physical living, others says it's life after death while yet others believe it speaks of health and wealth. The Life Jesus spoke of is Life as God defines it, the Life that He Himself is. God is bring us into the very State of God; this is Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus cannot be catagorized as the best of anything, to say He is the most powerful, the wisest or the greatest, is to say He you can be classified with other people or beings as being one of them. Jesus is not in any class, He is existence itself, He is the one who defines what power is, and is the fullness thereof, all things are Perfected in Him. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We are not called to be connected to Christ, or even to be His followers, we are the Manifestation of Oneness with Him. The fullness of God is not something we pray for or request for, it is the reality of Perfection, there is no experience of the resurrection without His fullness. God in Christ has made us one with Himself! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The folly in human reasoning is that greatness can only be defined in relation to something else, that is to say comparison is the premise on which accomplishment is noticed. The saddest part is that this reasoning is used to define the greatness of Jesus and His Perfection, but there is no comparison when it comes to Perfection, there is only the state of Christ as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Father's heart for all creation is Perfection and His desires shall be manifest. There is no force, law or system strong enough to deny God's will and purpose, rather all things tend towards Him and His truth. Creation is not heading to destruction as many think, it is being pulled into Christ and into His state; Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

At the core of Christ coming to die for mankind is the eternal defeat of sin and it's consequences, that man may manifest God to all Creation without having to struggle with self condemnation. Perfection is not something to be attained it is the state of Christ as He is, it is where we begin not where we end.  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the Ressurrection there is no hope or faith, there is only Christ manifest as the reality of all things. Hope is a positive expectations of the future, that proves that there is a discrepancy between the here and now, and the life one desires for themselves. In Perfection there is no time, there is no future to hope for or expect, there is only the Permanent experience of Christ in His fullness. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the Old Testament God dealt with His people based on obedience, in the New Testament He dealt with all people based on Relationship, it is this relationship that yields results in a believers life. In the Kingdom all things are based on Perfection, God's dealing with all Creation is Oneness; being brought into the experience of the Person of Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection the standard of all things is Christ as He is, you don't compare your life or situation to other people past or present because there is no comparison or pursuit of a better life, there is only one state that is Christ and His fullness. Perfection is also not contentment, acceptance or settling it is Oneness with Christ as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Jesus you know is the Jesus you will show, the reality of the life that one manifests is directly proportional to their revelation of God. If your belief system is programmed wrongly, the output of you life will not be consistent with Truth. This is why in Perfection God has brought us into Himself to know Him as we are known. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God is not looking for employees, the mindset of working for God has kept people from the ultimate purpose of God's call on their lives. The call of God is to those whom He foreknew and predestined to be conformed into the image of His son; Jesus the risen Christ. You are not call be an employee of God rather you are called to oneness with Him. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The transaction that took place on the Cross was the great exchange, where Jesus took our shame, guilty, sickness and death, to give us His everlasting life. In the ressurrection there is no transaction there is only the manifestation of God bringing all things into Christ, it is the change of state and the experience of Perfection for all things. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The question that most people have is whether or not God is in Control of things, they want to establish who has the reins of Creation. The desire and purpose of God is not to have control over things, but for all things to be in Oneness with Himself, this is what Jesus revealed to us in the ressurrection, this is Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus' resurrection was the changing point in all the universe, is in the place where the functions of time and space collapse. Perfection cannot be fit in a time frame or in any spatial arrangement, it is only set in the manifestation of the fullness of God in all Creation, that is the Kingdom.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Power of the word of God is not that the Lord is faithful to fulfil it, nor is it in the fact the God is a promise keeper. The Power of God's Word is the existence of all things, Words that frame time past and time yet to be, Words that are God Himself, manifest and experienced. The Word of God doesn't merely tell you what to do, He brings you into the fullness of God Himself, as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The freedom we have in Jesus is freedom into rest, all labour has been removed out of the way that we may stand in the fullness of God's finished work. Rest is a state Perfection where the Kingdom of God is established and manifest, it is where all creation is brought into it's fullness. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest hindrance to Truth is the state and view point of the observer, the reality of God that one experiences weighs heavy on their state and position in existence, Jesus is the same everywhere and to everyone, however the experience one will have of Him in there lives is dependent on their dispensation. Perfection is the state where we see and know Him as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fullness of God cannot be expressed when you are looking for a part or temporal answer, that is to say you cannot see the fullness of God in healing, deliverance provision or anything which partly or temporally solves an arising crisis. Christ is manifest in His fullness in the bringing of all things into Perfection, this is where the Divine Energy of the Holy Spirit is fully revealed.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection, the Kingdom experience is activated on all things, this brings all creation into it's ordained original state, to function at it's highest purpose, a state where all things reign with Christ. This manifestation is a place of fullness and Glory, were nothing opposes God, but rather all thing submit to their original purpose in Him! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Many people have been raised into a mindset about God and His desires for man, that keep them out of His fullness, if the best you see in Christ is Him being a Healer, Savior, Provider and Deliverer, you will never see or experience Perfection. God's desire is not temporal fixes but rather a complete change of state, into Oneness with Himself. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The solutions to what the world as a whole, or what each person is facing cannot be solved by more Power. There is a notion that many hold on too, stating a need for more power to sort out the problems faced on Earth today, however the real solution is Jesus in His fullness, not coming to give solutions but at the fullness of all things; Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Poverty, sickness, demons etc, are not the enemies to Perfection, for Perfection does not come in parts or phases. The Resurrection Life of God pulls into it's reality all things that pertain to everything and anything. Perfection is not relegated to a denomination or sect, neither is it just for mankind only, It is for all creation, past, present and future. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The religious mindset pushes God further away from man and makes it seem like He wants nothing but worship from us in exchange for blessing and protection. This has never been God's model for us in Christ, God desires to bring us into the fullness of Perfection and the reality of His Person, His very state; Oneness! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest power is that which was wrought for us by Christ in the resurrection. Jesus being born from death and coming into the fullness of life, is not a product of prayer or great confession, it is the working of the full load of His Power, the same power that raised Jesus from the dead and brings all things into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The realm that is governed by time is one which man exercises Hope, Faith and Patience. These virtue are good, they however point to the fact that things are changeable and not permanent, Jesus has brought Perfection, the Manifestation of God's unchanging state to all Creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the Lord of All Creation, not just Christians. There is so much entitlement that many believers have when it comes to Jesus in relation to other people and Creation. This was the same entitlement the Jews had over God, where they ostracized all other races of people, Perfection however cannot be bound to a group or sect, it is for all creation, not even those who have gone ahead can get it without us. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the fullness of how God desires all creation to be, He is Perfection. Many have settled for just knowing Him or just being close to and worshipping Him, but there is something else that God has prepared for us; Perfection, it is not wrought by human effort, it is the working of the same Spirit that raised Jesus from the dead.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Creation responds to it's Creator, it knows His voice very clearly, the longing of every created being is to manifest is full potential, and fulfill it's place in the grand design of things. Jesus is the fullness of all things, the highest and best that all creation can be, this is Perfection, God's desire for all things. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The reality of Perfection is the manifestation of the risen Christ in all things, this is the desire of God, He has subjected all things to the manifestation of Christ, only therein is true purpose and fulfilment. Creation is groaning for Oneness with God and this is only facilitated by the Holy Spirit. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The truest form of Joy is the manifestation of God original purpose for all Creation. Joy is not something that comes from what one receives, rather it comes from ones existence coming into alignment when the Perfect will of God, this brings the spirit, soul, body and environment to be in oneness with God. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus doesn't reign in the Earth apart from you, He is one with us and we reign together in Life with Him, He actually reigns through us. God's Perfection is seen through our manifestation of His fullness on all things, bringing all creation to the state of the risen Christ. Take you kingly position, reign in every sphere of human interaction; excel and express Perfection in every endeavor. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

If what you have can be lost, stolen or shaken, then it is not Perfect, That which is Perfect cannot be lost, it stands throughout all ages unscathed by neither time nor circumstance. Jesus is Perfection and the desire of God is to bring all Creation into how He (Jesus) is, to be totally free from corruption, and to stand in oneness with Him.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is a huge difference between Jesus who walked the Earth and the One who rose from the dead. In as much as He is the same person, the revelation of His manifestation is beyond someone coming back to life, like Lazarus. The risen Christ is the manifestation of Perfection for all Creation, He is the epitome of God standards for all things. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Authority in the hands of a servant manifests as an addiction to control and the desire to be in charge, Authority in the hands on a son manifests as a resource to bring positive change in a situation and expansion the expansion of the Father's desire. Jesus in His ressurrection declares all authority in Heaven and on Earth is given unto Him, it is through this authority that He perfects all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The manifestation of worship is not the words of a song, or how long one can kneel or prostrate themselves, true worship is when Creation functions in the highest purpose for which it was created, in this state it manifests the Perfection of the Creator to it's fullest, being brought into Oneness with Himself. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The mentality of fighting and battle is what many see as spirituality, however that is a clear indicator of the realm of understanding that one is standing in. Jesus in His ressurrection brought all things unto Rest, all things are made subject to God's Perfection and tend towards Him. All Creation is called into manifested Rest in Christ, brought about by the Holy Spirit. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Confession and meditation cannot bring about Perfection, Perfection is the manifestation of the risen Christ in all things.
This happens by the power of God, it is the manifestation of the Holy Spirit in His Fullness! Jesus in the resurrection showed us what happens at the full expression of God's power; the Perfection of all things, being brought into their original state.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Glory of Perfection is the manifestation of God's original purpose for all things, to the point that if just one area is left out, it's not Perfect. Perfection does not come in parts or phases, one doesn't grow into Perfection, we manifest Perfection in it's fullness once and for all. Jesus is Perfection, He is the fullness and God's original state of all things. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The human body is always reaching out to it's Original disposition; Rest, not death as some suppose, but rest which is the fullness of Christ. God intended for our bodies to be free from all the struggles and not liable to any form of destruction or decay, This is the work of the Holy Spirit on the Human body; _the same Spirit of Him that raised Jesus from the dead._
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The simple things of God are wiser than the highest wisdom of man, in Christ is Perfection, we don't base the standard of things on anything that has been attained or achieved before. Jesus is the acme of what anything can be, He is the fullness and original intent of all creation.  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The sweet fellowship of the Holy Spirit is not there to just give is a spiritual high, rather the desire of God is for us to come into His fullness. It is the work of the Holy Spirit to bring us into Perfection, it is infact the manifestation of Himself on Creation that is Perfection, for therein is Christ revealed in Fullness, As He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Where we are now is not about what is said, but rather it's about Jesus and His fullness in manifestation. Anything that is not Christ Manifested will be removed for it is shakeable. Creation is groaning for an experience with God that cannot be shaken but one that is permanent, One that is not just in word or revelation but is a tangible manifestation of Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The radius and influence of the reign and Authority of Jesus Christ in the Kingdom is over all things. The Lordship mandate of Jesus' Kingdom reign is seen over even the things that one may consider as enemies, for He must bring all things into Oneness with Himself, this is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection calls for us to drop Religion and Traditions, It cannot be experienced in the prevailing systems of both the physical or spiritual realms, Perfection is the reality of the risen Christ!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The value system of the Kingdom of God is very different from that of the world, in the Kingdom, value and worth are not defined by status, wealth or influence, in the Kingdom of God Righteousness, peace and Joy in Holy Spirit form the basis and standard of value. The Kingdom is Love manifested. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
